name: Upstash landing page by upstash.com
description: A serverless-data-platform landing page built on a mint-to-green gradient canvas with oversized display typography that shifts from gradient-filled hero text to a full-bleed 'Fast Anywhere' band over a dotted globe. The page alternates airy white rounded cards and dark terminal blocks, using a bento grid for the platform section, numbered feature columns inside the product panel, big green stat numerals, a script-type testimonial with a lozenge logo wall, and a minimal centered footer. Density rises in the middle (code, pricing boxes, diagrams) and relaxes again toward community and footer, giving the long page a clear light–dense–social rhythm.
